title: Password-first / OIDC-off Auth Mode Evidence Matrix
decision_summary: Google OIDC disabled; password-first is default. Google login must not be presented or callable when OIDC is off; password login must not depend on Google client secret.

evidence_items.description: Single authoritative resolver for OIDC on/off decision at shared/auth/mode.py; default is 'local' (password-first)
evidence_items.observation: Module docstring references ODP-WEB-PASSWORD-FIRST-AUTH-CONTRACT-001 and ODP-WEB-OIDC-OPTIONAL-DEPLOYMENT-001. AUTH_MODES = ('local', 'oidc'). Default is local (password-first). Three consumers pinned: auth_mode.sh, validate deployment, API auth boundary.

evidence_items.description: Web runtime resolves ODP_AUTH_MODE / ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED; OIDC enabled only when mode=oidc and all OIDC vars present
evidence_items.observation: isOidcEnabled() function at line 131; resolves ODP_AUTH_MODE and legacy ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED flag; conflicts between mode and legacy flag raise error; default without either var is local (OIDC disabled).

evidence_items.description: Login route conditionally shows OIDC button only when authMode === 'oidc'
evidence_items.observation: Line 342: const showOidc = authMode === 'oidc'; OIDC button HTML only rendered when showOidc is true. provider=oidc request returns 404/503 when authMode !== 'oidc' (line 303-308).

evidence_items.description: OIDC callback route fail-closed when OIDC is disabled
evidence_items.observation: When provider=oidc but authMode is not oidc, error WEB_AUTH_PROVIDER_DISABLED is returned. No OIDC provider is contacted.

evidence_items.description: Deployment validation only requires OIDC vars when auth_mode=oidc
evidence_items.observation: Line 44 imports resolve_auth_mode; line 1426 resolves auth mode; line 1434 conditionally checks OIDC vars only when auth_mode=='oidc'. Password-first deployments pass validation without any OIDC variables.

evidence_items.description: Terraform checks only enforce OIDC settings when oidc_enabled is true
evidence_items.observation: Lines 76, 238, 275: conditions gate OIDC checks behind local.is_prod && local.oidc_enabled. Password-first default does not require OIDC variables for terraform validate/plan.

evidence_items.description: Password login path does not require Google OAuth client secret
evidence_items.observation: localAuth.ts handles password credential verification against identity store. No OIDC client secret referenced. Session created via sessionStore.ts using ODP_WEB_SESSION_SECRET (not OIDC secret).

evidence_items.description: Session, CSRF, and callback validation not weakened when OIDC is off
evidence_items.observation: Session uses __Host- prefix with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax. Login throttle persists in identity.login_attempts (loginThrottle.ts, 29KB). CSRF via Origin check in route.ts. These mechanisms are independent of OIDC provider state.

evidence_items.description: Formal E2E receipt from ODP-WEB-PASSWORD-FIRST-SECURITY-E2E-002 covering T26-T30 matrix items
evidence_items.observation: Receipt verdict=pass, date 2026-09-01. Covers: password login success/fail, account/IP threshold, production fail-closed, local default/OIDC disabled, complete OIDC optional path, RBAC tenant isolation, secret exclusion. Python auth suite: 151 passed, 22 skipped. Web suite: 474 tests passed across 53 files.

evidence_items.description: API AuthenticationBoundary supports multi-issuer: local, oidc, service
evidence_items.observation: config.py references ODP_AUTH_MODE / ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED as authoritative OIDC gate (lines 70, 186, 285). When OIDC disabled, OIDC tokens are not verifiable by the boundary.

evidence_items.description: Ops test that validates deployment with and without OIDC
evidence_items.observation: File exists (35344 bytes). Validates conditional OIDC deployment across environment matrix. Part of E2E receipt verification suite.

evidence_items.description: Live Google OAuth provider availability and credential verification
evidence_items.observation: Not inspected. No live GCP or external OIDC provider is contacted by the existing receipt. The HUMAN-GCP-WEB-OAUTH-CLIENTS-001 task remains in 'todo' status, owned by Human/Ops. Provider verification is not required for password-first operation.
evidence_items.note: Provider verification is a B-stage concern; this A-stage evidence package does not claim provider readiness.
